title: 3D Objects Counter+: morphology-filterable 3D object counting for Fiji/ImageJ
description: Extension of the classic Fiji 3D Objects Counter (Bolte and Cordelieres, 2006) with morphological filters (sphericity, compactness, elongation, volume, surface area, Feret diameter, intensity), a public Java API, and macro-recordable workflows.
